research.title: Baseline Classification with Incomplete Tabular Data
bullets: Prepared tabular datasets by checking missing values, standardizing feature encodings, and separating training and evaluation records according to the prescribed protocol.
Implemented logistic regression and random forest baselines with imputation pipelines, documenting predictive performance and calibration across specified missingness conditions.

work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against order documents, recorded discrepancies, and routed unresolved quantity or packaging issues to the appropriate staff.
Maintained stock records, organized routine order paperwork, and coordinated collection schedules with staff to support daily dispatch operations.

projects.title: Regularized Regression for Demand Estimation
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression baselines for tabular demand estimation, using training data to fit feature scaling and categorical encodings.
Selected regularization settings through cross-validation and examined residual patterns to compare baseline behavior across low-demand and high-demand observations.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Baselines for Customer Segmentation
bullets: Applied standard Gaussian mixture and k-means implementations to standardized purchase features, comparing assignments under alternative covariance assumptions and initialization settings.
Examined cluster profiles and assignment stability across repeated fits, documenting how feature scaling influenced the resulting segmentation.
